name: v2src-v8rev
desc: THE author's own new lever: `probe22+v8rev` enables a fifth Raptor view - the native384-v8 checkpoint read BACK TO FRONT - at weight 0.10. The upstream comment calls 0.10 'a sane first try'. It is nearly free because the reversed view shares a volume recipe with native384-v8, so the arm-grouping rewrite decodes the study once for both. This is a view nobody in the public ecosystem has reported scoring, and it is the only lever found so far that is BOTH new and cheap.
